objectives.statement: Recognize and build the pattern modal in simple past plus ha plus past participle.
Choose the right modal for unreal past meaning: intended, would have, should have, or could have.
Connect conditional perfect forms with past hypothetical clauses such as hvis jeg hadde visst det.
Find and fix the common error of using an infinitive after ha instead of a past participle.

notes: Must teach modal preterite + ha + past participle for unreal past situations, regret, missed obligation, and unrealized possibility. Do not allow infinitive main verbs after ha.
